reasoning.text:
[p0 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Fresh level 1, no world model. Probe each of the 4 directional actions once (each diff logged separately) to learn whether they move the cyan/pink cursor brackets or cycle glyphs.

[p1 | acting_agent | action_plan]
up/down cycle the pink glyph at cursor; press up x5 on position0 to record the full pink-alphabet cycle order (each step logs a frame), needed to compute target glyph press-counts. Cyan word is fixed reference; legend is not a simple lookup/transform.

[p2 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Continue enumerating the pink up-cycle (currently at id5) to find full alphabet and wrap point; needed to test whether pink cycle can reproduce cyan-word shapes (identity goal) since legend lookup cannot cover 4/5 positions.

[p3 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Lock pos0 to its target legpk[3] (up x2 -> P5). Then move right to pos1 and press up once to probe whether each slot has its own per-slot cycle containing its translation target legpk[4], validating the cyan->pink legend-translation goal (synth identity goal is impossible: alphabets disjoint).

[p4 | acting_agent | action_plan]
pos0 locked to legpk[3]. Cursor at pos1 whose cycle is disjoint; press up x3 to advance pos1 toward its target legpk[4] (=#####/#...#/#.###/#.#.#/#####), reading each frame to find the offset and stop when reached.

[p5 | acting_agent | action_plan]
slot1 target legpk[4] not yet seen in idx0-4 of its cycle; press up x2 to reveal idx5/idx6 (cycle len ~7) and locate the target offset, minimizing overshoot.

[p6 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Lock slot1 to its target (down idx6->idx5 = r180(legpk4)). Then right to slot2 and up x3 to begin enumerating slot2 cycle to find the unique dihedral variant of legpk[0]=its target.

[p7 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Slots0-2 done; move cursor slot2->slot3 (right) then down once which engine predicts lands slot3 on a dihedral variant of legpk1 (its target).

[p8 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Slots0-3 confirmed at target. Move cursor slot3->slot4 (right), then down x2 -> slot4 reaches dihedral variant of legpk2. All 5 slots match; engine reward_function predicts (1.0,True) i.e. Level1 solved.

[p9 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L2 spelling cipher. Cursor at yellow slot0. Probe slot0 cycle: 4 ups to enumerate glyphs and locate dihedral variant of target T0=#.###/..#../..#../..#../###.# . Will read resulting frames next call.

[p10 | acting_agent | action_plan]
slot0 done(offset4). Move cursor right to slot1, then up x4 to enumerate slot1 cycle and locate dihedral variant of T1=#.#.#/....#/#.#.#/....#/#####. Read frames next call to find exact offset; slots may share one 7-ring so this also maps more of it.

[p11 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Shared 7-ring; up=+1 idx. slot1 at R5 needs +1 up ->R6=T1. Then right to slot2 (at R6), up x3 ->R2=T2. Verify both land on dihedral variants of their targets next call before doing slots 3-6.

[p12 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Slots0-2 confirmed matched. Cursor at slot2. Right->slot3 (R4), up x2 ->R6=T3 (done). Right->slot4 (R2), up x1 (toward R5, 2 more next call). Verify slot3 lands on dih variant of T3 next call.

[p13 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Slots0-3 matched. Cursor at slot4 (now R3 after prior +1). up x2 -> R5=T4 (done). Right to slot5 (start R2), up x2 (toward R5, 1 more next call). Verify next call.

[p14 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Slots0-4 matched. Cursor slot5 (needs +1 up to R5=T5). up; right->slot6 (R3); down x3 -> R0=T6. This sets all 7 yellow slots to targets -> level should solve (score up).

[p15 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 word-translation cipher solved on paper: 7 cyan targets known. Cursor at cyan slot0. Probe slot0 ring with up x4 to map shared ring order and locate dihedral variant of TC0=..#../#####/#.#.#/#.#.#/..#.. . Read frames next call.

[p16 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Slot0 cyan ring offsets0-4 mapped (RC0-4). TC1->RC4,TC2->RC3,TC6->RC2 known; TC0,TC3,TC4 must be in unrevealed RC5/RC6. up x2 to reveal RC5,RC6 (slot0 to offset6), completing the 7-ring so I can compute every slot path.

[p17 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Full ring mapped. slot0 already=TC0 (R6). Cursor slot0. right->slot1, down x2 (R6->R4=TC1 done). right->slot2 (R6), down x1 (toward R3, 2 more next). Per-slot remaining: s2 3down,s3 2down,s4 3up,s5 2down,s6 2down. Verify next call.

[p18 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 step72: slots0,1 match targets (TC0,TC1). Cursor on slot2. slot2 ringidx5->target3 = 2 down; then right to slot3 (idx5->target3) = 2 down. Down=-1 ring idx. Remaining after: slot4 3up, slot5 2down, slot6 2down.

[p19 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 step77: slots0-3 match targets. Cursor on slot3. Right to slot4, up x3 (idx2->5=TC4, up=+1), then right to slot5 for next call. Remaining after: slot5 2down, slot6 2down.

[p20 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 step82: slots0-4 match. Cursor on slot5. slot5 idx6->4 = 2 down; right to slot6; slot6 idx4->2 = 2 down. This completes ALL 7 cyan slots -> Level 3 should solve (score 2->3).

[p21 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4: decoded cipher (Pink ref -> P->Y->C legend chain -> Cyan targets [8,11,1,7,11,8,1]). Need cyan ring cycle order to compute moves. Probe slot0 with 6 ups; each step logs a frame so I can reconstruct the full 7-glyph ring order and up-direction. slot0 target=id8; will set correctly after mapping ring.

[p22 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4: cyan ring idx {12:0,13:1,14:2,8:3,11:4,7:5,1:6}, up=+1. Targets idx [3,4,6,5,4,3,6]. Cursor on slot0 (idx6->3): 3 down. Then right to slot1 (idx1->4 needs 3 up): 1 up now, 2 more next call. s3 already done.

[p23 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4: slot0,3 done. Cursor on slot1 (idx2->4): 2 up. Then right to slot2 (idx3->6 needs 3up): 2 up now, 1 more next call. up=act1.

[p24 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4: slots0,1,3 done. Cursor on slot2 (idx5->6): 1 up. Then right past slot3 (done) to slot4 (idx6->4): 2 down. Leaves s5 up3, s6 down1.

[p25 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4: slots0-4 done. Cursor on slot4. Right to slot5 (idx0->3): 3 up. Then right to slot6 (needs 1 down) for final call. Only s6 remains after.

[p26 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4: slots0-5 all match targets. Cursor on slot6 (idx0->6): 1 down completes all 7 cyan slots -> Level 4 solves (score 3->4).

[p27 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 new level. Cursor is at TOP-left legend box (rows7-19, cols9-13), not between bottom strips as in prior levels. Ambiguous which region is editable. Probe: up(1) to see if a glyph cycles, right(4) to see if cursor navigates. Read per-step frames to learn the mechanic before planning.

[p28 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 cracked: top grid editable, PINK boxes use L3 ring, CYAN use L1 ring, up=+1. Targets=bottom ref words (pink L3 [5,2,6,6,1], cyan L1 [5,3,3,0,6]). Cursor on slot1(cyan,cur0->tgt5): down2. Right to slot2(pink,cur1->tgt2): up1. Right to slot3. Will sweep right then handle slot0(left) last. Verifying nav as I go.

[p29 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5: cursor now brackets the WHOLE double box (slot3+slot4, cols42-53) - a new mechanic. Both need +1 (cur2->tgt3). Test single UP to learn whether a double box cycles BOTH glyphs together or just one, before planning the rest. Slots1,2 already confirmed matched.

[p30 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 double-box probe confirmed: 1 UP cycles BOTH glyphs of a double box together (s3,s4 now match). Sweep right through remaining stops: right->[s5s6 dbl pink], DOWN sets both to idx6 (tgt), right->s7 cyan, up+up sets 5->0 (tgt). Cursor row1->row2 nav unverified-watching. Remaining after: s8 up3, s0 up3.

[p31 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 8/10 matched (s5,s6,s7 set last cycle). Cursor on s7. Right->s8 (pink), up x3 sets idx5->1 (tgt, up=+1 mod7). Leaves only s0 (top-row leftmost, needs up3) for next call.

[p32 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 9/10 matched; only s0 (top-leftmost) needs up3. Cursor on s8. Two rights should wrap s9->s0 (short path, 2 moves vs 6 left). Navigating first (harmless) to verify cursor lands on s0 before issuing 3 ups, so I never risk cycling the already-correct s9. Next call: up x3 to finish.

[p33 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 final slot: cursor confirmed on s0 (wrap worked). All 9 other slots match. up x3 cycles s0 idx2->5 (pink L3 target), completing all 10 -> Level 5 solves (score 4->5).

[p34 | acting_agent | action_plan]
New L6: cursor brackets legend-row0 cyan box. Net-zero probe (up then down) to confirm the cyan legend box is editable and reveal its ring neighbors without disturbing state, before mapping the cyan->pink->yellow chained cipher targets.

[p35 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Cyan legend box confirmed editable (probe [1,2] net-zero). Map the cursor traversal order with 3 pure-nav rights (no glyph change, reversible) to learn which legend boxes are editable stops before committing to a goal/target mapping.

[p36 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 rings decoded (cyan=L3,pink=L1,yellow=L2). Firm sub-goal under all hypotheses: cyan boxes must equal cyan word [3,4,2]. Cursor on yellow-row0; ACTION4 moves to cyan-row1, ACTION1 (+1) sets it idx3->4 (its target). Verifies nav direction+edit before completing the cyan boxes and testing the chain goal.

[p37 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Step back: only CYAN boxes confirmed editable; PINK/YELLOW editability is the unobserved fact that decides the L6 goal. From cyan-row1(box4): right to pink-double(box5) and UP to probe editability, then right twice to yellow(box7) and UP to probe. Their diffs distinguish cyan-only-match vs two-word-match vs full-chain hypotheses.

[p38 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Fix cyan-row2 box8 5->2 (down3) to match cyan word, then navigate cursor 4x right to cyan-row0 box0; next call up3 completes cyan boxes=[3,4,2]. Cyan-boxes-match-cyan-word is necessary under all goal hypotheses.

[p39 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Cursor on cyan box0; up3 sets it 0->3, completing all 3 cyan boxes = cyan word [3,4,2]. Tests the cyan-boxes-match-colour-word goal (L5 mechanic). Watch for reward on the 3rd up.

[p40 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Begin building cipher-chain legend (row0). Nav box0->box1 ACTION1 (pink-double [2,0]->[3,1]); ->box2 ACTION2 (pink-single 4->3); ->box3 ACTION2 (yellow 5->4). Targets per verified CSP that makes legend encode cyan word->yellow word.

[p41 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Clean no-reset full build of cipher-chain target firsts [3,3,3,4,2,1,5,2,4,5,1,6] from box0; decisive L6 reward test.
